audit_summary.notes: Slice-wide CFA L1 mis-attribution: 13 of 13 CFA-L1-only cards had legacy citations pointing to Vol.1 pp.300-360 (Probability Distributions + Sampling) when actual quant-regression content lives in R7 Linear Regression at Vol.1 pp.431-479 (PDF 447-495). Of those 13: 6 had pages corrected to the real R7 location; 6 had topics that do NOT exist in CFA L1 2022 Quant scope (AIC/BIC, ARCH, decision trees, influence/leverage, LASSO/penalized regression, PCA, time series foundations) — citations point to nearest-related R7 content as placeholder anchors; 1 had wrong-volume correction (qm-structured-data-ml from Vol.1 to Vol.6 R55 Fintech). The 4 multi-source econometrics cards (cb-arb-factor-construction, panel-cb-factor-inference, signal-validation-oos-discipline, volatility-model-garch-multivariate) all passed clean — Damodaran-style topical issues did not recur because econometrics textbook citations land in correct chapters. CFA L1 2022 Quant scope: R1 TVM, R2 Organizing Data, R3 Probability, R4 Probability Distributions, R5 Sampling, R6 Hypothesis Testing, R7 Simple Linear Regression. ML/CART/LASSO/PCA/Time-Series are L2/L3/raw-econometrics scope.

cards.title: AIC and BIC for Regression Model Selection
cards.summary_curated: Information criteria AIC and BIC compare regression models by trading off in-sample residual fit against a parameter-count penalty; AIC's 2(k+1) penalty is constant in n while BIC's ln(n)(k+1) penalty grows with n, so BIC favours more parsimonious models. AIC/BIC are not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods.
cards.audit_notes: AIC and BIC information criteria are not covered in CFA L1 2022 Volume 1 Quantitative Methods (R1-R7). The closest CFA L1 2022 anchor is R7 Section 4.2 'Measures of Goodness of Fit' (Vol.1 pp.451-452, PDF 467-468), which lists R-squared, F-statistic, and standard error of estimate as the only fit measures discussed. AIC/BIC topic is post-2022 curriculum addition (CFA 2024 ML reading) or L2 quant material. Legacy citation Vol.1 pp.300-360 (PDF 316-376) lands in R4 Common Probability Distributions / R5 Sampling and Estimation, which is unrelated to model selection. | R4 re-anchored cites [0, 1] to ['qm_eslii_2009_2ed'] (adversarial support-verification).

cards.title: ANOVA Table for a Fitted Regression
cards.summary_curated: The ANOVA decomposition for a fitted regression partitions total variation SST into the regression sum of squares SSR plus the error sum of squares SSE; mean squares MSR and MSE are formed by dividing each component by its degrees of freedom, and their ratio F = MSR / MSE is the joint-significance test statistic for the slope coefficients.

Pages corrected to point at the R7 ANOVA decomposition (SST=SSR+SSE) and the ANOVA-table presentation. CFA L1 2022 R7 covers SIMPLE linear regression only, so the multi-regressor F(k, n-k-1) statement in the card is broader than the source's H0:b1=0 form, but the underlying partition is identical.

cards.title: ARCH(1) Conditional Heteroskedasticity

cards.title: Classification and Regression Trees (CART)
cards.summary_curated: CART is a non-parametric supervised learning algorithm that partitions the feature space by recursive binary splits at decision nodes; terminal nodes predict the majority class for classification problems or the terminal-node mean for regression problems. CART is not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods; the parametric counterpart in R7 is simple linear regression.

cards.title: Influence Analysis: Leverage, Studentised Residuals, Cook's Distance
cards.summary_curated: Per-observation regression diagnostics: leverage h_ii flags unusual predictor profiles, studentised residuals flag aggregate outliers, and Cook's distance combines both to identify observations whose deletion would materially move the fitted coefficients. These quantitative diagnostics are not in CFA L1 2022; R7 only mentions outliers descriptively.

Quantitative influence diagnostics belong to L2 or raw econometric references (Greene / Wooldridge). cards.title: Multiple Linear Regression Foundations
cards.summary_curated: Multiple linear regression posits Y_i = b_0 + sum_j b_j x_{ji} + e_i with linear-in-parameters specification and the four classical assumptions (linearity, homoskedasticity, independence, normality) making OLS the best linear unbiased estimator. CFA L1 2022 R7 covers the simple-LR case (k=1) only; the multi-regressor extension is named in the F-test null.

cards.title: LASSO Penalised Regression
cards.summary_curated: LASSO augments the OLS sum-of-squared-residuals with an L1 penalty lambda * sum |b_j|; for large lambda some coefficients are shrunk exactly to zero, giving simultaneous regularisation and automatic feature selection. LASSO is not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods; R7 covers the unpenalised OLS criterion only.

cards.title: Principal Components / Dimensionality Reduction
cards.summary_curated: Principal components analysis (PCA) rotates a standardised feature matrix onto orthogonal axes ranked by explained variance; the analyst keeps enough leading components to cover a chosen cumulative-variance threshold and discards the rest. PCA is not in CFA L1 2022 Quantitative Methods; R7 only covers simple linear regression with its scalar predictor.
